items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Sharky's band, you know with the Caravan, was it Dudley LeBlanc's Caravan, Paticone, that was a good band.

ctx.x: But George, I thought he was terrific. His tone was almost too good for jazz. But he didn't like it. He wanted to get a tone like I got. He was trying to find a pea shooter trumpet and I said boy don't change. He was terrific. Of course he didn't have the range Armstrong had. And I'm very George, I thought he was the best we had. And I still think my idea that the bass of Street Six was the best New Orleans band we had in the last twenty years. Well I mean Sharky had a good know. Sharky's band, you know with the…
And I get the little Louie, throwing it on the Louie Tones. You got energy enough for one mower?
